name: Medulloblastoma: cisplatin, lomustine (CCNU), vinCRIStine after craniospinal radiotherapy (Packer-type; per-drug doses VERIFY)
histology: medulloblastoma (embryonal tumor; molecular groups WNT, SHH, group 3, group 4)

biomarkers.SHH_pathway: tested (vismodegib is an option for SHH-pathway mutations at recurrence)
biomarkers.note: Molecular group informs risk stratification and recurrence options (for example vismodegib for SHH-pathway mutations). No biomarker gates the primary combination here. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), CNS Cancers, Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy.

treatmentSetting: adjuvant (concurrent weekly vinCRIStine during craniospinal radiotherapy, then multi-agent maintenance)
lineOfTherapy: first-line adjuvant, following maximal safe resection and craniospinal radiotherapy

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: weekly vinCRIStine given concurrently with craniospinal radiotherapy, then maintenance cisplatin/lomustine/vinCRIStine
eligibilityCriteria.locator: Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy (regimens following weekly vincristine with concurrent RT during craniospinal RT), cns.txt lines 2431 to 2433

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: standard-risk regimens follow reduced-dose craniospinal irradiation (23.4 Gy) plus a posterior fossa boost
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer 12th ed.
eligibilityCriteria.locator: devita.txt lines 242361 to 242367 (lomustine, vincristine, cisplatin for eight cycles following 23.4 Gy CSI)

drugs.name: CISplatin

provenance.locator: Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy (Cisplatin/Lomustine/Vincristine preferred), cns.txt line 2433; regimen named in DeVita 12th ed. devita.txt line 242361; no per-drug mg/m2 dose is printed in either source

drugs.notes: CISplatin is a named component of the preferred Cisplatin/Lomustine/vinCRIStine maintenance regimen (Packer-type), but neither cited source prints a per-drug mg/m2 dose. basis, dose, and unit are VERIFY (ISMP tall-man CISplatin; do not confuse with CARBOplatin). Requires renal function, magnesium, and audiometry monitoring when dosed.

drugs.name: Lomustine (CCNU)

provenance.locator: Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy (Cisplatin/Lomustine/Vincristine preferred), cns.txt line 2433; DeVita 12th ed. devita.txt line 242361; no per-drug dose printed

drugs.notes: Lomustine is a named component; no per-drug dose printed in the cited sources, so basis, dose, and unit are VERIFY. Delayed and cumulative nitrosourea myelosuppression applies; the 1000 mg/m2 cumulative warn threshold is source-grounded in the nitrosourea cumulative-toxicity discussion (devita.txt lines 15373 and 15407), while the 1100 mg/m2 hard stop is a StewardMD institutional safety margin above it and is not printed in the source. Cyclophosphamide may substitute for lomustine in an alternative preferred triplet (cns.txt line 2432).

drugs.name: vinCRIStine

provenance.locator: Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy (weekly vincristine with concurrent RT; component of the preferred triplet), cns.txt lines 2431 to 2433; DeVita 12th ed. devita.txt line 242361; no per-drug dose printed

drugs.notes: vinCRIStine is given weekly during concurrent craniospinal radiotherapy and as a component of the maintenance triplet, but neither cited source prints a per-drug mg/m2 dose, so basis, dose, and unit are VERIFY. The ISMP tall-man 2 mg per-dose cap is carried regardless (vinCRIStine is IV only, fatal if given intrathecally).

premedications.name: CISplatin hydration and antiemesis
premedications.notes: CISplatin requires pre- and post-hydration and highly emetogenic antiemetic prophylaxis when dosed; specific regimen VERIFY.

supportiveCare: highly emetogenic antiemetic prophylaxis on CISplatin days (regimen VERIFY, no CISplatin dose established here)
cumulative nitrosourea myelosuppression monitoring across cycles
vinCRIStine: IV only, never intrathecal; monitor neuropathy and constipation

monitoring: CBC with platelets before each cycle and at the delayed nitrosourea nadir
renal function, serum magnesium, and audiometry when CISplatin is dosed
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each vinCRIStine dose

doseModificationRules.condition: renal impairment, ototoxicity, or delayed cytopenia
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. CISplatin renal/ototoxicity and delayed nitrosourea nadir require confirmation of recovery and dose adjustment; physician decides. Per-drug doses are VERIFY.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: CNS chapter, devita.txt lines 242361 to 242367 (lomustine, vincristine, cisplatin for eight cycles following 23.4 Gy CSI; component-named, no printed per-drug dose)

guideline.locator: Adult Medulloblastoma: Systemic Therapy, cns.txt lines 2431 to 2433 (weekly vincristine with concurrent RT; preferred Cisplatin/Cyclophosphamide/Vincristine and Cisplatin/Lomustine/Vincristine; Packer reference cns.txt line 2454)

provenanceNote: The Packer-type framework is grounded: weekly vinCRIStine concurrent with craniospinal radiotherapy, then a preferred maintenance triplet of CISplatin/Lomustine/vinCRIStine (or CISplatin/Cyclophosphamide/vinCRIStine) per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), CNS Cancers (cns.txt lines 2431 to 2433, Packer reference cns.txt line 2454), delivered as eight cycles after reduced-dose 23.4 Gy craniospinal irradiation per DeVita 12th ed. (devita.txt lines 242361 to 242367). Neither cited source prints a per-drug mg/m2 dose, so the CISplatin, Lomustine, and vinCRIStine basis, dose, and unit are the literal VERIFY (listed in verifyFields) and were NOT invented; only the eight-cycle count and the ISMP vinCRIStine 2 mg cap and lomustine cumulative caps are carried. cycleLengthDays is VERIFY. No hospital or endorsement claim. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
